Amit Shah to inaugurate Anti-Narcotics Task Force chiefs' conference

Union Home Minister Amit Shah will inaugurate the third national conference of chiefs of Anti-Narcotics Task Force (ANTF) on Tuesday. The conference will focus on tackling the drug menace and progress made on the Vision Document on Narcotics Control (2026-29). The event aims to strengthen efforts against drug networks.
